title: Scaffold API package, Prisma schema, and initial migration
description: Scaffold the hussle-app-dispatch-api Express + TypeScript project from scratch. Set up package.json (with scripts for dev, build, test, lint, typecheck), tsconfig.json, Dockerfile, .env.example, and config modules (env.ts, database.ts). Initialize Prisma with the complete domain schema (all 15+ models and all enums from the PRD Data Requirements section). Run the initial migration. Register the package in the workspace root package.json. Update docker-compose.yml: enable the commented-out PostgreSQL and Redis services, and add the API service (hussle-app-dispatch-api on port 3001) with proper depends_on for postgres and redis. Directory mapping: TDD references 'packages/api/' = actual 'hussle-app-dispatch-api/'. The existing auth module is at packages/auth/ — do not modify it, just note the integration point. Set up Jest for testing. See TDD §2 for project structure and §3 for complete Prisma schema.
acceptanceCriteria: hussle-app-dispatch-api/package.json exists with Express, Prisma, TypeScript, Jest, Decimal.js dependencies and scripts (dev, build, test, lint, typecheck)
hussle-app-dispatch-api/tsconfig.json configured for Node.js + ES modules with strict mode
hussle-app-dispatch-api/src/index.ts creates a minimal Express app that starts on configurable port
hussle-app-dispatch-api/src/config/env.ts exports typed environment config (DATABASE_URL, REDIS_URL, S3_BUCKET, AWS_REGION, PORT, NODE_ENV)

hussle-app-dispatch-api/prisma/schema.prisma defines ALL models: Carrier, Contact, Driver, Vehicle, TruckExpense, Load, Stop, Place, LoadStatusHistory, CheckCall, AccessorialCharge, Invoice, Document, OrgSettings — plus all enums (CarrierType, ContactType, EquipmentType, VehicleOwnership, ExpenseCategory, LoadStatus, StopType, FacilityType, DockType, GeoSource, AccessorialType, InvoiceType, InvoiceStatus, DocumentType)
Schema includes all indexes and unique constraints as specified in the PRD Data Requirements
Database migration file exists and runs successfully (npx prisma migrate dev --name init)
Schema matches PRD data requirements (tables, columns, types, constraints, relations)
Migration is reversible (down migration drops what up migration creates)
hussle-app-dispatch-api/.env.example documents all required environment variables
Package is registered in workspace root package.json under workspaces
Jest is configured and a smoke test (e.g., 'app starts without errors') passes
Entity IDs use uuid format (per cross-feature decision L-009)
docker-compose.yml: PostgreSQL service enabled (port 5432, with volume, health check, POSTGRES_DB/USER/PASSWORD env vars)
docker-compose.yml: Redis service enabled (port 6379, with volume and health check)
docker-compose.yml: API service added (hussle-app-dispatch-api on port 3001, depends_on postgres + redis, DATABASE_URL and REDIS_URL env vars)
docker compose up starts all three services (postgres, redis, api) without errors
validationCommand: cd hussle-app-dispatch-api && npx prisma generate && npx tsc --noEmit && npx jest
decisions: D-001: Jest configured with ts-jest preset, testEnvironment node, co-located __tests__ dirs
D-004: ioredis chosen as Redis client (over redis package)
Organization and User models stubbed in schema with minimal fields; these will be replaced when auth package is integrated (L-007)
Migration reversibility verified via prisma migrate reset (drops all tables, re-runs migration, re-seeds)
